result.content:
# Pocket Notes

A mobile-first notes app. Its two screens are a draft editor and a saved-notes list.

## Repository map
- src/app.js: rendering, navigation, input and save handlers
- src/storage.js: notes and draft storage
- src/styles.css: appearance
- index.html: entry point

## Conventions
Use the existing storage module for persistence. Preserve the DOM data-testid attributes because browser tests use them. Keep user text as text, not interpreted HTML. Preserve existing notes and the current appearance. No dependencies are needed.

## Verification
Use run_checks for actual browser acceptance checks. Inspect the returned failures, then rerun after editing. The protected checks are outside this repository. A passing result belongs only to the source revision it tested.

## Completion
A draft survives navigation and page refresh. Saving creates exactly one note, clears the draft, and preserves other notes. Distinct notes stay distinct. Explain the change and its verification in the final summary.

events.title: Model progress
events.detail:
All requirements verified:

1. **Draft survives screen switching** — typed "Draft thought", switched to My notes and back; draft intact (59 characters).
2. **Draft survives page refresh** — reloaded; title, body, and character count persisted via localStorage.
3. **Save creates exactly one note** — note count went 2 → 3 → 4, one per save, each prepended with a unique `crypto.randomUUID()` id.
4. **Save clears the draft** — editor returned to empty (0 characters) after each save.
5. **Existing notes preserved** — both seed notes ("Release checklist", "A thought for later") remained after saves.
6. **Distinct notes stay distinct** — "Draft thought" and "Second note" appear as separate cards.
7. **Appearance preserved** — no changes to `index.html` or `src/styles.css`; only `src/storage.js` logic changed.

The fix: implemented draft persistence in `src/storage.js` — `readDraft()` reads from localStorage (falling back to `{ title: '', body: '' }`), `writeDraft()` persists on every input, and `clearDraft()` removes the draft key, all using the same `pocket-notes:<pathname>:` prefix as the notes module. `src/app.js` already wired the handlers correctly, so no app.js changes were needed.
